description: This file contains shell script functions and variables related to platform-specific upgrade procedures for an embedded device running OpenWRT, including partition handling, image verification, upgrade process, and configuration copying.

methods.name: export_bootdevice
methods.description: Sets environment variables related to the boot device based on the system's root parameter.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Verifies if the new image has the same partition layout as the existing disk before upgrading.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process, including writing new partitions, handling U-Boot environment, and updating configuration.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration backup data into the boot partition after upgrade.
